mapper.select: SELECT event_id, event_type, source_incident_id, request_body_hash, webhook_status, incident_id, incident_status, incident_version, response_body_json FROM mock112_webhook_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mock112_webhook_event ( event_id, event_type, source_incident_id, request_body_hash, webhook_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{sourceIncidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{requestBodyHash}, 'RESERVED', #{now}, #{now} )
mapper.update: UPDATE mock112_webhook_event SET webhook_status = 'COMPLETED', incident_id = #{incidentId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, incident_status = #{incidentStatus}, incident_version = #{incidentVersion}, response_body_json = #{responseBodyJson}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
